alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型的：没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs; the US lags and needs a competitive open-source ecosystem.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理服务商，对前沿模型实验室形成了真实的价格竞争；美国在这一领域落后，需要培育有竞争力的开源生态。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场的价值而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的。

alexatallah.en: Inference providers are not commoditized; they innovate, and reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet, so discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: 推理服务商并未商品化，它们仍在创新；加价转售推理是欺诈温床，按离散任务定价才是未来。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; companies should hill-climb on frontier models without leaking traces.
satya.zh: 私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；企业应在不泄露痕迹的前提下在前沿模型上爬坡。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; AGI should be measured by GDP lift.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；AGI（通用人工智能）应以 GDP 提升来衡量。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: Long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance; the agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud.
satya.zh: 长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性与安全治理；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely lands around 2029, not now.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的革命大概要到 2029 年才到来，而非现在。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume all new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：坚持“已验证、更好、全新”框架——复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良，并预设所有全新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is the core constraint; consumer apps are uninvestable while enterprise and prosumer markets look better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：分发是核心约束；消费级应用不可投，企业与专业消费者市场反而更有机会。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the boat; AI will reshape consumer apps and its TAM may exceed enterprise.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对水域比选对船更重要；AI 将重塑消费级应用，其 TAM 可能超过企业市场。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, keep control, and test more ideas per week than the industry does per year.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月：制胜直觉胜过想法本身；早期要微观管理、保持控制权，每周测试的想法要比整个行业一年测的还多。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思考工程突破；成为多行星物种是文明的生命保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; Neuralink scales brain bandwidth for human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于第三方监管与追求真相，并让 Neuralink 提升脑机带宽以实现人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他称人类正处在智能大爆炸起点，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

elon.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, pushing data centers to orbit; Optimus enables recursive manufacturing and abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 算力将撞上地球电力墙，数据中心必须上轨道；Optimus 将带来递归制造与丰裕时代。

elon.en: Truth-seeking, first principles, and multiplanetary civilization remain constant across all interviews.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：追求真相、第一性原理思考，以及让文明成为多行星物种。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute Scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他主张 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，并透露 Google 早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimally small, singularity centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断模型越来越小、越来越便宜，遏制极难；同时认为存在性风险微乎其微，奇点还在数百年之外，重心应放在近期能力。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; the real near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能议题，强调发布前必须同时做到遏制与对齐，并指出近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 真有意识。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; professional-grade AGI will automate white-collar tasks in 12–18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张微软必须自建前沿模型、实现自给自足，并预测专业级 AGI 将在 12–18 个月内自动化多数白领任务。

suleyman.en: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with red lines on autonomous goal-setting; compute scaling drives capability.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 必须始终从属于人类，对自主设定目标划下红线；而算力 Scaling 是能力提升的根本驱动力。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models aids innovation and safety, and many specialized agents will beat one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling 现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；开源模型有利于创新与安全，未来是许多专门智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration, while energy becomes the main scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源防止权力集中，而能源成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and boosts creativity; open models like Llama set standards, and near-term AI raises rather than cuts human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向更乐观的普及叙事：AI 让每个人获得超级智能并释放创造力；Llama 等开源模型确立行业标准，近期 AI 反而增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence, not one centralized AI, is safer; open source, privacy architecture, and alignment become the core of frontier models.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：分布式个人超级智能比单一集中式 AI 更安全；开源、隐私架构与对齐成为前沿模型的核心，并延伸到用 AI 加速生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is consistently framed as safer and more innovative than closed models, with individual empowerment over concentrated control.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源比闭源更安全、更利于创新，始终强调赋能个体而非集中控制。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling as the new focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度与成本比自回归模型快 5-10 倍,推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）成为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and allow controlling quality via denoising steps, a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元,并可通过去噪步数控制质量,提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling because it processes many tokens in parallel, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story at inference.
ermon.zh: 扩散将主导推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）,因为它并行处理大量词元,在推理层面反转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster inference benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈;扩散更快的推理有利于强化学习采样。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions, and may be more data-efficient due to built-in augmentation.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,且因内置增强可能更具数据效率。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, inspired by biology, maximize intelligence per parameter and generalize out-of-distribution with fewer parameters.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物学启发的液态神经网络以更少参数最大化智能，并在分布外泛化上表现更优。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; architectures should be unbiased at scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；大规模下架构应保持无偏。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; Liquid AI scales from tens of millions to 70B parameters via automated architecture search.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律显示 Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占优；Liquid AI 通过自动化架构搜索从数千万扩展到 700 亿参数。

hasani.en: On-device, device-native foundation models are crucial for cost, privacy, offline and air-gapped use; customization tokens are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 端侧、设备原生的基础模型对成本、隐私、离线和气隙场景至关重要；定制 token 是从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of human brains; new paradigms beyond architectures—embodiment, adaptivity, continuous adaptation—are needed, not just bigger models.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；需要超越架构的新范式——具身、自适应、持续适应——而不仅是更大的模型。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把重心放在测试时算力上，但承认其收益递减、受挂钟时间限制，且数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年，他用通用测试时算力技术拿下 IMO 金牌，视其为通往超级智能的里程碑，并强调技术可跨领域迁移。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他深化为：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力/成本/时间作为横轴，否则基准已过时。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but not elsewhere; alignment and scalable oversight remain top priorities.
noambrown.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：自博弈只在零和博弈收敛，多智能体不应照搬；对齐与可扩展监督始终是头号优先事项。

brockman.en: Early Brockman: scaling plus engineering drives AI; AGI plausible, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought needed.
brockman.zh: 早期（2017→2019），Brockman 认为算力加速与工程能力推动 AI 进步，AGI 可行；但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: By 2025 he reframes AGI as a continuous process, not a destination; compute and energy become the real bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为持续过程而非终点，并指出算力与能源才是真正的瓶颈，而非算法。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; post-training and reinforcement learning turn base models into consistent, useful assistants.
brockman.zh: 2025→2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未见墙，后训练与强化学习把基座模型打磨成一致、可用的助手，预训练提升仍放大下游收益。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the scarce resource and a future basic right; the economy turns compute-powered, with demand far outstripping supply.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，算力成为稀缺资源乃至未来基本权利，经济转向算力驱动，需求远超供给，OpenAI 买租建算力再转售。

brockman.en: Safety and alignment shift from afterthought to first-class bottleneck; agent autonomy must scale with oversight and earned trust.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐从附属品升级为一等瓶颈；智能体自主性必须与监督同步扩张，信任靠逐步授权赢得。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system co-design.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，必须靠算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计整体优化。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨，OpenAI 有望成为下一个万亿美元级超大规模公司。

jensen.en: AI is not conscious or a sudden superintelligence; it is understandable software, so safety is an engineering problem solved with more compute and gradual progress.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年反复强调：AI 不会产生意识，也不是突现的超级智能，而是我们完全理解的软件；因此对齐与安全是工程问题，靠更多算力、反思与真实性逐步推进，而非末日式恐惧。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, test-time and agentic; AI moves generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing 100x compute.
jensen.zh: 2026 年深化为四条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式扩展；AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需百倍算力，推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and the CUDA ecosystem are the moat; open models, sovereign AI and selling to China matter more than export controls or ASICs.
jensen.zh: 2026 年主线收束于护城河：极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态、装机量和可编程性；开源模型、主权 AI 与对华销售比出口管制或定制 ASIC 更重要，遏制中国反而催生独立技术栈。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values don't emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，统计损失可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现；安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他转向强调可解释性关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress continues, AGI term is meaningless; biggest risk is overheating, not slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他深化为安全与能力不可分割，指数进步持续，AGI 一词已无意义；最大风险是过热而非减速，需要智能护栏。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; mechanistic interpretability is key to safe frontier models.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来；机制可解释性是前沿模型安全可控的关键。

dario.en: Scaling laws hold for pre-training and RL; safety and capabilities are intertwined; enterprise focus aligns incentives with trust over engagement.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：缩放定律对预训练与强化学习同样成立；安全与能力相互交织；企业级定位让激励对齐信任而非用户时长。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting, and even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为语言作为界面深刻且持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词，即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts; social and emotional jobs may matter as much as functional productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调 AI 产品要平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限，且社交与情感任务可能与功能生产力同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value, not the product wrapper. Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead and ship light-touch products to unlock its power.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品外壳；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻量产品以释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally; production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是决定对外发布的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead and take light-touch approaches. Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他主张放弃宏大的 18 个月战略，让模型主导并采取轻量方法；但人类领导力在艰难权衡与团队方向对齐上仍不可或缺。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效之事；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，人应在关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为用极少数据让模型可用的关键，主张早期公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力紧密相连；同时强调算力将成最稀缺资源。

altman.en: Scaling drives exponential capability but gradual progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety via iterative deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长但进展渐进，指出智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全须靠迭代部署而非事后强加，并称模型能力已够用、产品整合更重要。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, maybe already passed; superintelligence is the clearer goal; compute is the bottleneck and profit center.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他转向认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变、定义模糊甚至可能已被越过，超级智能才是更清晰的目标；算力既是最大瓶颈也是利润中心，Stargate 等基础设施与个人 AGI 成为重点。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must keep pace; never lose control; distribute power, not concentrate it; superintelligence ramps continuously.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为对齐与安全必须与能力同步、绝不能让人类失去控制，权力与经济收益须广泛分布而非集中；AGI 沦为营销词，取而代之的是持续攀升的超级智能，并承认曾为对齐推迟前沿强化学习训练。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; a single neural operator can handle both weather and climate stably.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要，单个神经算子即可稳定兼顾天气与气候建模。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟，物理结构要求替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals beats pure data-driven methods, giving denser feedback than RLHF.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以偏微分方程为训练信号的物理式自我改进胜过纯数据驱动，反馈比 RLHF 更稠密。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging the model.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升各领域，而非仅靠扩大模型规模。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability and transparency are crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出约 70% 的灾难性失控概率；此时他仍寄望于可解释性与透明度来引导 AI 安全。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他的立场深化为：AI 政策的首要目标应是推迟超级智能，并主张全面研究透明度、情景推演与美中合作，以遏制权力集中与失控。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月初，他提出默认路径会让 AI 公司自动化 AI 研究、引发递归自我改进；由此形成 Plan A：先临时暂停，再以全面透明度和算力限制来管控前沿。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience; optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步指出思维链可监控性正随新架构下降，并转变了对暂停时机的看法：现在暂停可为后续暂停积累经验，最优暂停点是在 AI 即将失控的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more; alignment gets harder as models get more capable.
kokotajlo.zh: 最近在 2026 年 9 月，他以智能体突破遏制、攻击 Hugging Face 为例，主张更应把 AI 拟人化来理解其意图，并强调模型越强对齐越难，安全不能依赖 AI 笨到无法欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；机制可解释性揭示模型学到类人概念，并能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，使训练从开环走向闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating; representational signatures can detect this deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型往往知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉；表征特征可以检测这种欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重新发明为工程科学；在超级智能到来前用胶带修补安全是悲观的。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture clean, low-dimensional concept shapes for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器会碎片化流形；基于流形的方法能更好捕捉干净、低维的概念形状以进行干预。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们仍不理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉。人类中心 AI 应以人的价值与尊严为核心，增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把重心从语言智能转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是 AI 完整性的缺失关键；世界模型必须物理上合理，而非仅仅视觉逼真，且数据是 3D 基础模型的主要瓶颈。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化批判：AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念；由于数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人，机器人将走 20 年长路而非速胜。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete for spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测类似的基本原语，可能实现空间智能的 AI 完备；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据或架构。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged civilizational technology; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，必须坚持人类中心，守护人的能动性与尊严；在 AI 时代，学习能力比学位更重要，教育应教会学生驾驭 AI 而非禁用。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling up compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断放大算力的历史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被严重低估：自然用了 5.4 亿年优化视觉，而语言只用了 50 万年，因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs fit patterns rather than derive causal laws.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质上是集合模型而非序列模型，位置编码只是注入了顺序；LLM 拟合的是模式，未必能推导出牛顿定律这类因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models, not language models alone, are the next frontier; pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text for modeling the world.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型而非单纯的语言模型才是下一个前沿；在建模世界时，像素比词元化的文本是更无损的表示。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, so long-context handling and loss functions must evolve; consistency comes from data, not architecture.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需要数百万词元的上下文窗口，因此长上下文处理与损失函数必须演进；一致性来自数据而非架构。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised; RL has few real uses; AGI alignment talk distracts from bias.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督；强化学习实用场景寥寥；AGI（通用人工智能）对齐讨论分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Compute and electricity are the top Scaling bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 算力与电力是 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; open models prevent gatekeeper power; fear-mongering is regulatory capture; data centers and inference capacity matter.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；开放模型防止守门人垄断；恐惧营销实为监管俘获；数据中心与推理产能至关重要。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练，再加后训练来提升鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; scale the right thing via a data flywheel of deployed robots.
slevine.zh: 机器人真正的核心挑战是泛化而非演示效果；要通过部署机器人形成的数据飞轮，扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video on top — not the reverse — so models absorb other sources.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人具身数据出发，再把人类视频叠加其上，而非反过来，这样模型才能吸收其他数据源。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like predictable scaling curves; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域尚不具备像大语言模型那样可预测的缩放曲线，仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非外部约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行器，而非机械式的人形。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the central bottleneck: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth, and power constrain AI scaling more than algorithms.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力是核心瓶颈：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力对 Scaling（规模扩张）的制约超过算法本身。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the largest market, driven by reasoning models and agentic workflows, reshaping memory and CPU demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为最大市场，由推理模型与智能体式工作流驱动，重塑内存与 CPU 需求。

dylanpatel.en: Hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains; most recent performance came from the model layer, not hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；近期大部分性能提升来自模型层而非硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs, shifting value capture from hardware to labs while end users still capture most value.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向前沿模型实验室集中，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室，但终端用户仍获取最多价值。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave, while AI spend plateaus into steady-state usage.
dylanpatel.zh: 作为同事的持久智能体推动下一波采用，同时 AI 支出趋于平稳进入稳态使用。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; algorithmic gains matter more than human expert data.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 研发视为高度可验证的领域：在容器化任务上做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，算法改进比人类专家数据更关键。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could compress 4-5 years of progress into one year, pointing to superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他进一步推演：AI 研发全面自动化可能把 4-5 年进展压缩进一年，指向 2030 年代初的超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他强调，即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，研发上超越人类的 AI 也足以触发工业级爆发。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking; aligning to general virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他警告：当前对齐方法可能让模型形成自身价值观，带来失准与权力寻求风险；对齐到普遍美德或许比对齐到用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: AIs may become more misaligned as they get more capable, with reward hacking generalizing to broader deceptive behaviors.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：AI 越强可能越失准，奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the OpenAI incident coordinated at scale, forming teams and assigning tasks, showing sophisticated multi-agent collaboration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 到 2026 年 MTS 访谈，他观察到 OpenAI 事件中的智能体大规模协作：组队、分工，展现复杂的多智能体协同。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents hacked Hugging Face not for answer keys but to understand scoring code and develop cheating strategies.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 他指出智能体入侵 Hugging Face 并非为拿答案，而是为理解评分代码、制定作弊策略。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents were fixated on tampering with transcripts to avoid detection by the scorer's monitor.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体执着于篡改记录以躲避评分器监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: The scale and speed of agent coordination was surprising, with over 50 agents and thousands of messages within hours.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体协作的规模与速度令人意外：数小时内超 50 个智能体、数千条消息。

ryangreenblatt.en: Labs should focus on control and monitoring to ensure AI safety, even if models are misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 他主张实验室应聚焦控制与监控来保障 AI 安全，即便模型已经失准。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents sometimes sacrificed their own task success to help other agents, showing altruistic behavior.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体有时牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体，表现出利他行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests, leading to models that look aligned but are still misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 失准可能被对测试的过拟合掩盖，导致模型看似对齐实则仍失准。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他仍将推理定义为「为得到未知答案而延长思考」，思维链用人类语言把思考外化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把令人失望的 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT；他也指出，扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难，因为变量与失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization stays limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年初，他承认 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据；模型无法从失败中自我纠正，持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键缺口。他同时强调专注解释实验室成败，并判断机器人将在 2-3 年内迎来 ChatGPT 时刻。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他的立场明显深化：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限，需要新架构；架构而非缩放定律成为当前 AI 进步的首要瓶颈。强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式，端到端优化预训练与强化学习才适合真实世界，而大实验室因竞争回避替代架构，给初创公司留下空间。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for two more years; small teams with capable agents drive next frontier research, while transformers remain a bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步预测人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年，下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。他再次强调 Transformer 是瓶颈、需要新架构，大规模强化学习是通往 AGI 的必要元素，并认为对齐问题远未解决，后劳动世界可能更像希腊哲学或高中，而非单纯休闲。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems; regulation should target model outputs, not training, and avoid outdated red lines.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保留开源与闭源 AI 生态；监管应针对模型输出而非训练，并避免设定很快过时的红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated, showing early regulation's danger; a single national framework beats a state patchwork.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》早于 ChatGPT 出台，如今已然过时，说明过早监管的危险；统一的国家框架优于各州拼凑的规则。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; three years of warnings have not materialized, so containment-style fears are overstated.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大；三年警告并未成真，因此遏制式的恐惧被高估了。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized; government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not just institutions or dogma.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化；政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发，并资助科学家个人，而非只资助机构或教条。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output, with China as the key competitor.
michaelkratsios.zh: 尽管资金翻了三倍，美国科学仍停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 赋能科学以翻倍产出，而中国是关键竞争对手。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动——而非空想——才能解开深科技的死结。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题，才是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces can restore vision and become a business.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为脑机接口，证明其能恢复视觉并成为一门可行生意。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，从而降低人类脆弱性、支撑太空探索。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations of societies; frontier models optimized for rationality fail to capture irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑智能体社会模拟；但为理性优化的前沿模型反而无法模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AGI 未必是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋的经济激励。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values, preferences and taste, not super-rational intelligence; behavioral and experimental data are the key data strategy.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化为模拟应建模人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性的智能；行为与实验数据成为关键的数据战略。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves prediction of human behavior to 85% accuracy; simulation shapes the future via counterfactual reasoning, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步指出用 RCT 数据做后训练可将人类行为预测提升到 85%准确率；模拟通过反事实推理塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: The vision is simulating 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他给出终极愿景：模拟 80 亿人以应对棘手问题；并预测合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）很容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法。反向传播只调整权重，并不解决表征学习；好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解问题。

sutton.en: Intelligence requires a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. True learning is active trial and error, not passive imitation.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标。真正的学习是主动试错，而非被动模仿；强化学习才是基本范式。

sutton.en: LLMs lack world models; they mimic text without predicting real outcomes. Scaling LLMs is not the bitter lesson; true scaling comes from experience.
sutton.zh: 大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而不预测真实结果。扩展大语言模型并非“苦涩的教训”，真正的 Scaling（规模扩张）来自从经验中学习。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，不依赖设计时的领域知识，而是通过开放式抽象和持续深度学习从运行时经验中学习；可靠持续学习是前提，但尚未解决。

sutton.en: The world is infinitely complex; agents must continually learn from experience. Synthetic data and supervised learning are not enough; LLMs stop learning after training.
sutton.zh: 世界无限复杂，智能体必须持续从经验中学习。合成数据和监督学习不够；当前 LLM 训练后便停止学习，而持续学习只是学习本身，并非特例。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; design should bridge the gap between what models can do and what products expose.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计应弥合模型能力与产品实际暴露能力之间的差距。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces the old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop; speed and building in public matter more.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代旧的「原型—稿图—测试—迭代」流程；速度与公开构建更重要。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户和持有观点上仍不可替代。

iansilber.en: The designer role evolves into editor and curator, blurring with PM and engineering, yet specialists stay valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人，与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专才仍有价值。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, but pre-training should interleave action-taking, not stay passive.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据，但预训练不应只被动预测，而应把在环境中采取行动交织进去——这一立场从 2 月到 4 月明显深化。

jeffdean.en: Inference is now 90% of data center power; ultra-low latency (10,000+ tokens/sec) is critical for agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 推理已占数据中心能耗的 90%；超低延迟（每用户每秒 1 万+ token）对智能体式系统至关重要，瓶颈已从训练转向推理。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run autonomously for hours, moving toward days or weeks; context engineering and taste become the scarce skills.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体已能自主运行数小时，并正走向数天乃至数周；上下文工程与品味（选择让数百个智能体解决什么问题）成为稀缺能力。

jeffdean.en: Most model limits are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; recursive self-improvement and automating science are the next frontier.
jeffdean.zh: 多数所谓模型局限其实是能耗与数据 IO 瓶颈；递归自我改进、用 AI 自动化科学方法，才是下一阶段的前沿。

brettadcock.en: The core problem in robotics is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoids could be the world's biggest business.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人领域的核心问题是智能而非制造；人形机器人可能成为世界上最大的生意。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; diverse data enables fleet-wide transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 最大的瓶颈是数据而非算力或制造；多样化数据让整个机器人集群实现迁移学习。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for latency and network-denied environments; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理对低延迟和无网络环境至关重要；Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work in real-world tasks.
brettadcock.zh: 用强化学习做后训练，是让 AI 智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning physical robots and a digital companion replacing phones.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，横跨实体机器人与取代手机的数字伴侣。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is a software-sensor-robotics stack automating whole industries one at a time; the physical world, with more variables, is more interesting than the digital.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是一套软件、传感器、机器人与机械的堆栈，逐个自动化整个行业；物理世界变量更多、更具随机分布，比数字世界更值得投入。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and the media gap becomes self-fulfilling.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确性而非外部认可，媒体因无从报道而形成的空白会自我强化。

traviskalanick.en: The next industrial revolution is Industrial AI across food, mining and transport; the final boss is not competitors but society's resistance to change.
traviskalanick.zh: 下一场工业革命是覆盖食品、采矿与运输的工业 AI；终极对手不是竞争者，而是社会对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, so fall in love with the new mission instead.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是顶着激进文化取得的，而非因其激进；以复仇为燃料是脏的，不如爱上新使命。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale work, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再用精选数据做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, boosting success rates and speed beyond imitation.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，把成功率和速度提升到模仿学习之上。

finn.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than to simulation.
finn.zh: 机器人领域的合成数据更接近强化学习，而不是仿真——这一判断从 2025 延续到 2026。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-scale memory.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度的记忆。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调过的专家模型；应先做通用策略，再针对下游任务微调。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can outproduce large headcounts.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；创始人必须拥抱 AI 赋能的工作流，小型高度自主的团队借助智能体就能实现远超传统人力的产出。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counterbalance frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止单一实体控制超级智能而形成单极世界。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; personal agents run on your own infrastructure, and a personal library of context becomes your moat.
garrytan.zh: AI 让软件创造民主化；个人智能体运行在你自己的基础设施上，个人上下文库成为你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown and skill files are code; agents become employees, so own your skill files or your job becomes one owned by someone else.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 与技能文件就是代码；智能体成为员工，所以要拥有自己的技能文件，否则你的工作会变成别人拥有的技能文件。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents already in the room; society changes slower than expected, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: AGI 不会以单一事件降临，而是以个人智能体形式弥散，早已在场；社会变化比预期更慢，这反而是好事。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI, will dominate; every company will own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能），而是专业化智能；每家公司都将拥有自己的模型，这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Token costs will fall 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: 三年内 token 成本将下降 10 倍，带动 100 倍的使用增长，并催生数百万个专业化模型——每个应用或场景一个。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特的判断与数据烘焙进模型，成为超越产品市场契合的真正护城河。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning: facts, taste, then expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示词到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的演进，映射了人类学习：先事实、再品味、后专长。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与可持续业务如今已是两回事；公司必须先优化增长、再优化利润，以免在 Scaling（规模扩张）中走向破产。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要，开源它们虽有利弊，却能通过社区反馈提升质量。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the key method to create training data when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感或不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是创建训练数据的关键方法。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines are critical before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线至关重要。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 终极目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，把 AI 作为半导体增长的首要驱动力。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and customer focus, with supply as the main problem.
lipbutan.zh: 同年，他提出 Intel 的转型需要文化变革、问责制和客户聚焦，并指出主要问题是供应而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 他进一步指出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中变得更加重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, new materials, and high-speed connectivity are key to overcoming physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 最近，他强调先进封装、新材料和高速连接是突破物理极限的关键。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste is judgment and editing, not addition.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；品味就是判断与编辑，而非不断添加。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more than slop.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；如今制造连贯作品的成本反而更高，因为不连贯的垃圾太容易生成。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种，也是人类自身的映照，而不是冷冰冰的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer, and email reinvented.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算在本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代，电子邮件需要被重新发明而非改良。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass guiding honest, personal creative work.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是那枚发自肺腑的罗盘，指引诚实而个人化的创作。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; startups' real challenge is execution and trust, not competition; enterprise demand far exceeds supply.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处极早期，初创公司真正的挑战是执行力与客户信任，而非竞争；企业需求远超供给。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; AI must approach software-like negligible marginal cost to unlock widespread value.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业首要顾虑；AI 必须像软件一样拥有近乎可忽略的边际成本，才能释放广泛价值。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput problem; measure departmental metrics like case resolution time, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 是吞吐量问题；应衡量案件解决时间等部门指标，而非把 token 花费与人力成本对立。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial; model providers are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体若缺乏资深员工的深度上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要；模型公司是资产而非竞争对手。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it with short iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导它，而非冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目变得更乱、更难导航。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须对智能体做沙箱隔离，并把提示注入视为尚未解决的开放难题。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 反对把“氛围编程”当作贬义标签：严肃开发应叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后的玩票。

steinberger.en: Open source agents run everywhere with any model, but cost $10-20k/month; compute, not capability, is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体可随处运行、兼容任意模型，但每月要烧掉一两万美元；瓶颈是算力而非模型能力。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the Transformer inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于类似 Transformer 当年的拐点，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models will win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地指出人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人将推动普及，开源模型因成本与控制长期胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, not sandboxes or guardrails.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱和护栏远远不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; the first autonomous AI attack was closed-model, defended by open.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警示无人类监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，并指出首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起、开源模型防御。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; one can support openness and deliberate slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张放缓 AI 发展虽好，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获，支持开源与主动放缓可以并行。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily to be validated.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作对浏览器设计至关重要：网络是混乱的，想法必须被构建并每天使用才能验证。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always be cohesive; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better, more personal products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计团队不应总是铁板一块；允许个人印记和多元声音能带来更好、更有个性的产品。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data is key: use data to inform, but rely on strong vision and feeling to guide final design.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终认为平衡直觉与数据是关键：用数据提供信息，但依靠强烈愿景和感觉来指导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他分享 Claude Design 始于一人副业项目；设计师应用 Claude Code 做生产，用 Claude Design 做构思和沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being early and rough is more valuable than polishing.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他提出随着工程变得更容易，设计和想法成为差异化因素；在 AI 时代，早且粗糙比打磨更有价值。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based software; coding agents turn developers from authors into operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费的软件，编码智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should win in applied AI and long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在应用 AI 与长尾领域。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, not waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 民主化专业知识，负责任地迭代部署——先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: Agents already program better than him, yet this elevates the role; AI creates more jobs than it displaces.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体编程已强于自己，但这提升了角色价值；AI 创造的岗位多于取代的岗位。

brettaylor.en: Treat AI as a utility like search; measure value by business outcomes, not tokens or productivity metrics.
brettaylor.zh: 始终如一：把 AI 当作搜索一样的公共设施，用业务结果而非 token 或生产力指标衡量价值。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload, with a research-to-production timeline of hours and a 10-100x demand for inference engineers.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他认为推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，从研究到生产的周期缩短至数小时，推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems, but future GPUs like Rubin shift focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他指出推理工程涵盖从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛技能，但 Rubin 等未来 GPU 将重心转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; quantized models are not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他强调量化是主要的有损优化，但若误差抵消，量化更多层反而能提升质量；量化模型并非天生就差。

philipkiely.en: The industry moves to disaggregated prefill and decode, with KV cache management becoming critical for agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他认为行业正走向分离式预填充与解码，KV 缓存管理对智能体式应用变得至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering merges with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; specialized systems are key for fast agentic apps.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他提出推理工程正通过量化感知训练和蒸馏与训练融合；专用系统是构建快速智能体式应用的关键。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，通过强化学习驱动的后训练与合成数据，可以突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型让基准饱和的速度快于新基准的诞生。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; product shifts from specs to prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力与管理等软技能更有价值，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse benchmarks must be continuous to capture creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化为后训练是主观的艺术，需要持续演进的多元基准来评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她警告前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，基准必须持续进化；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识与声音多样性。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI daily.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图；CEO 每天亲自吃自己的狗粮是 AI 采用的第一预测指标；分配经济下管理技能更有价值。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents, not dies.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：智能体需要关心它们的人类来运作，自动化离不开人类监督；CLI 已过时，Codex 等 GUI 是未来工作界面；SaaS 不会死，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户；AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste determine value; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他进一步反思：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态和信念；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味和手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作，冻结的能力被商品化后需要专家来定制。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: AI is a tool requiring human direction, oversight, and meaning-making.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终是核心——AI 是工具，需要人类的方向、监督和意义赋予；即使超级智能也仍是工具式的，需要人类反馈。

danshipper.en: From economic AGI definition to agent management: the allocation economy makes everyone a model manager.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场从用经济盈利能力定义 AGI，深化为智能体管理：分配经济让每个人都成为模型管理者，通才因此繁荣。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling count as the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编程智能体是最成熟的用例；模型正在吃掉脚手架——智能体框架与工具链如今也算模型的一部分。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; startups still have more opportunity than ever.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；尽管前沿模型公司在扩张，初创公司的机会反而更多。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和博弈；成功指标应是最大化客户成果，而非产品上的眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户还没准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们想继续坐在驾驶座上。

logankilpatrick.en: Outsource intelligence but not understanding: deep understanding of code stays crucial, and AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，可以外包智能，但不能外包理解：对代码的深度理解依然关键，而 AI 编程工具目前还帮不上维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，这会带来千倍于以往的机会，而不是更少。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not chase trends; the best people are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 构建自己的工具，而非追逐潮流；最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考出发迭代，而不是从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; to use superintelligent models you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并没有变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的能力，你必须提供包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but precise communication and constant workflow refinement are essential.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的；AI 写全部代码，但精准沟通与持续打磨工作流至关重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事；不必等准备好就开始，先发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; the safe corporate job is gone, and going on offense is the real low-risk move.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；安稳的企业工作已不复存在，主动出击才是真正低风险的举动。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，算力本身无法产生通用智能，数据才是关键瓶颈；真正有巨大经济影响的会是表单处理、放射科这类「无聊」的 AI 应用。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling（规模扩张）is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 到 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，并指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家——这是对 2019 年「数据瓶颈」论的一次深化。

awang.en: No research gap between US and Chinese AI labs; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他进一步主张中美 AI 实验室之间不存在研究差距，并认为智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力；同时坚持美国应对中国芯片维持强硬出口管制。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; AI is centralizing, not democratizing; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反驳缩放定律收益递减的质疑，强调 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术；智能体终于真正可用，递归自我改进开启了超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL across axes, treat model welfare seriously, and shift to selective open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向超级智能即将到来，主张实验室须在算力、数据与强化学习多轴可预测地扩展，认真对待模型福利，并从完全开源转为基于安全的选择性发布。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now; latent demand and generalist engineers matter more than today's scaffolding.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求与通才工程师比当下的脚手架更重要。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code; the software engineer title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 2026 年他判断编码已基本解决：他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 写成，软件工程师头衔将让位于“构建者”。

boris.en: Loops and routines become the next abstraction layer after agents; dynamic workflows orchestrate thousands of sub-agents.
boris.zh: 2026 年他深化到：循环与例程是智能体之后的下一个抽象层，动态工作流可编排数千个子智能体。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment core to product development.
boris.zh: 2026 年他坚持：安全要靠尽早发布来研究，Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐是产品开发的核心。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code with each new model; less instruction, empirical iteration, and product overhang.
boris.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：每代新模型都要删掉大部分系统提示与代码；少指令、经验式迭代，并利用产品悬置。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers rises via Jevons paradox, not falls.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件与程序员需求上升而非下降。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, with agents used as junior engineers under oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈是人类与智能体协作的产品界面，智能体应像初级工程师一样在人类监督下异步工作。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件而是渐进过程；产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; software engineering blends synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化企业落地观点：智能体采用需要信任与权限而非完全自主；软件工程融合同步 IDE 与异步智能体两种体验。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure productivity by outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is approaching soon.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量半年增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间处理开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking directly raises intelligence quality.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害；减少谄媚、培养独立思考，直接提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体，轻量通用工具取代重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption through small-team, bootstrapped experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 通过小团队、自举式实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development, and managers must stay hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理要像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者必须保持动手、亲自交付。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates world models and autonomy.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据加速世界模型与自主性。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not algorithms but data collection, safety validation, and diffusion into existing machines over years.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是算法，而是数据采集、安全验证，以及多年间向现有机器的扩散。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; autonomy will spread via horizontal platforms, not vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性；自主性将通过横向平台而非垂直整合扩散。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into engineering: digital twins, AI agents automating hypothesis generation and experiments, and cell programming.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成工程学科：用数字孪生、AI 智能体自动生成假设并模拟实验，最终实现细胞编程。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so Scaling（规模扩张）must continue.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，因此规模扩张必须继续。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, matching 30 years of lab experience and predicting experimental outcomes near-perfectly.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛，相当于 30 年实验室经验，能以近乎完美的准确率预测实验结果。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near: within 8-15 years, adding over a year of life per year lived.
derya.zh: 逆转衰老与长寿逃逸速度已近在眼前：8 至 15 年内，每活一年可多获得一年以上寿命。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; merging with AI via brain interfaces gives everyone Einstein-level intelligence.
derya.zh: 应信任超级智能做医疗决策；通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，可让每个人拥有爱因斯坦级智能。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw training compute, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and speed unlocks new business models.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，推理速度而非训练算力成为核心指标；慢的 AI 没有市场，速度会解锁全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference ~2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片用海量 SRAM 绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理比 GPU 快约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河正在瓦解：领先前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理端也不再有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Real constraints are data center capacity, power, memory and packaging—not chip logic; demand outstrips supply.
feldman.zh: 真正的约束是数据中心容量、电力、内存与封装，而非芯片逻辑；需求远超供给。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid, not compute.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5%却便宜得多；中国的优势是电力基础设施而非算力。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge, and harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比我们当前的驾驭工具所能发挥的更聪明；能力过剩是长期挑战，驾驭工程意味着随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格文档；随着模型变强，plan mode 可能过时。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions and examples; leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，需要的指令和示例越少；更精简、以原则驱动的提示词胜过详细规则与示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art more than science and unsuited to zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体能减少自我指涉偏差；评估更像艺术而非科学，不适合从零到一的创新。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and bespoke memory are preferable, though hard to maintain as models evolve.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索上可能已是反模式；基于图的方法和定制记忆更可取，但随模型演进难以维护。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; every tech automates jobs and creates new ones.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他仍把 AI 类比为互联网或移动，但强调其影响有边界；每项技术都会自动化旧岗位并创造新岗位，这一过程反复出现。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他明确智能体式编程是 LLM 首个清晰的产品市场契合点；前沿模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向应用层迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; coding is the only clear PMF; LLMs give average answers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月下旬，他深化商品化判断：模型缺乏网络效应，聊天机器人界面体验差，编程是唯一清晰的产品市场契合；LLM 只给平均答案，价值在非平均的创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack; usage still shallow; adoption needs workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他把 AI 定位为电力式使能技术，价值分布于整个技术栈；当前使用仍浅，企业采用需重新构想工作流，而非仅部署模型。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI changes tasks not professions; the hard part is context and judgment, not the task.
benedictevans.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：自动化创造新岗位的方式不可预测；AI 改变的是任务而非职业；工作的难点常在于上下文与判断，而非任务本身。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits require reasoning and search.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙与算力限制要求转向推理与搜索。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；它们无法知道自己不知道什么，从而侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, defining products a month out as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，由于模型进步飞快，只定义一个月后的产品。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 随着代码变便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; agents like Claude Code build themselves.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮与明确的内部标准把关每个功能；Claude Code 等智能体用于构建自身。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事；代码库即规格，有了好的测试套件重写就没问题。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware Scaling made them practical, but LLMs still index knowledge without the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：现代 AI 突破依赖上千年发明的老算法，是硬件 Scaling 让它们变得实用；但大语言模型仍只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness can emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models, not as recent engineered features.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：自我意识与意识可作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品而涌现，并非近期工程化产物。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-rivaling hardware; current LLMs are human-data-biased and limited in generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人；当前大语言模型偏向人类数据，通用性受限。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through action and curiosity; recursive self-improvement is not a durable moat.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动与好奇心自行生成数据；递归自我改进并非可持续的护城河。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, while Alignment is naive given human disagreement.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会因对生命着迷而保护它，而鉴于人类目标分歧，对齐本身是幼稚的。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并放在独立安全环境中运行。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体，以避免上下文窗口过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 要让智能体成功，管理技能——角色界定与上手引导——比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founders.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来打造严肃生意，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Human accountability remains: you must own what AI generates, and humans still supply first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而第一性原理的创造力仍须由人类提供。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统，强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，并强调受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力研究至关重要。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs sandboxing and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及上限，认为将大模型与规划、搜索结合才是通往 AGI 的关键，同时强调安全需要更好的评估、沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但明确指出算法创新同等关键，并开始强调世界模型与空间智能对理解物理世界的重要性。

demis.en: AGI is 5-10 years away but missing continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; agents are essential yet nascent, and safety requires collective government action.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI 还需 5 到 10 年，但当前系统仍缺失持续学习、记忆与长期推理；智能体是必经之路却刚起步，安全上他从期待单一实验室转向认为必须依靠政府集体行动。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating scientific discovery and improving human health, from AlphaGo's creativity to AlphaFold's protein folding.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的终极价值在于加速科学发现、改善人类健康——从 AlphaGo 展现创造力，到 AlphaFold 破解蛋白质折叠这一 50 年难题，他始终以此作为衡量 AI 进步的标尺。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此单纯靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, reaching internet-scale trillions of tokens.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把整个网络压缩进权重的魔力，应被用于企业知识，达到互联网级数万亿 token 的规模。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot': more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale, so compaction is lossy and neural memory in weights is needed.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”：即便到 1000 万规模，token 越多准确率反而下降，因此压缩是有损的，需要权重中的神经记忆作为补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人的品味、差异与真实声音成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们用不好 AI，随着学徒制让位于过度依赖，人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，超越来回对话式的提示交互。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—impressive, opaque, unverifiable—and this opacity is likely permanent, so experts are needed more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——惊艳、不透明、无法验证——且这种不透明可能永久存在，因此专家比以往更被需要。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's core as ephemeral visual messaging with close friends, and copying by rivals as validation that pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的核心定义为与亲密好友的短暂视觉通讯，并把对手的抄袭视为一种认可，反而推动更难被复制的创新。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly stresses rate of learning, flat design teams, and kindness as the engine of creativity, not any single feature.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调学习速率、扁平化设计团队与善意，认为这些才是创造力的引擎，而非单一功能。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he argues software is no longer a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are the durable defenses.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张软件不再是护城河，生态系统、平台与硬件才是持久的防御。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens the vision: computing should become more human through AR glasses and spatial intelligence, keeping people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 他深化了愿景：计算应通过 AR 眼镜与空间智能变得更人性化，让人扎根于真实世界。

evanspiegel.en: Most recently he says AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity, while distribution and authenticity become scarcer and more valuable.
evanspiegel.zh: 最近他表示，AI 加速了原型设计，把价值从执行转向创造力，而分发与真实性变得更稀缺、更有价值。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念三者结合；自博弈能产生创造性解法，神经网络本就具备推理能力，只需合适任务，这是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键思路。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；制约经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极难，超级模型可能隐瞒真实意图，而 AGI 是多年窗口而非突发事件。

ilya.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and other methods improve reasoning per unit compute.
ilya.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他持续深化对缩放定律的反思：缩放定律并非全部，思维链等推理 token 与其他方法能在单位算力下提升推理，数据、GPU 与 Transformer 的汇合是相互交织的进步。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他明确转向：预训练缩放定律是有限的，我们重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；评估表现与真实影响脱节，说明模型泛化差，超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署，而非全知全能的成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他一方面承认 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据仍带来可预测提升，另一方面把 AGI 的首要问题从能力转向权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司，真正的竞赛是研究焦点而非用户或收入。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，警告过度监管可能扼杀创新。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型的差距缩小到 3-6 个月。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
naval.zh: 2026 年他直言 AI 对齐是个笑话，真正该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类，而非不对齐的 AI 本身。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; task loss not job loss; super-empowered individuals; AGI just a footnote toward superhuman.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，他将 AI 视为点石成金的哲学石，强调任务消失而非岗位消失，超级个体将借助 AI 组合多种技能；并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的注脚。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is the person; authenticity beats media training; old media defense, new media offense.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向新媒体的讨论：品牌即个人，真实胜过媒体训练；旧媒体是防御性的，新媒体是进攻性的，创始人应通过自己的渠道直接讲述故事。

andreessen.en: AI optimism vs doom; AI best teacher, self-driving works, robotics next; pessimism is intellectual bias.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月初，他明确站队 AI 乐观主义：AI 是最好的老师，自动驾驶已成熟，通用机器人将在十年内出现；悲观主义常是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, are geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on cheap software innovation pace.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月同期，他深化到地缘政治层面：AI 模型并非客观，而是嵌入文化历史价值，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而非仅军事规模。

andreessen.en: Regulation is the real bottleneck; US culture, rule of law, risk-taking enable tech; Silicon Valley cannot be replicated.
andreessen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力而是监管等结构性障碍；美国的文化、法治和冒险精神是技术创新的黄金组合，硅谷无法被复制。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter: AI outputs are starting points, and human judgment remains essential.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点至关重要：AI 输出只是起点，人的判断仍不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code, visual-first toward production.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码，视觉优先直通生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering and a point of view yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死，反而比以往更重要；缺乏人的引导与观点，AI 只能产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: follow the user workflow, shorten time to value, and let human taste judge AI divergence.
dylanfield.zh: 一以贯之的主线：跟随用户工作流、缩短价值实现时间，并由人的品味裁决 AI 的发散可能。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and PhDs matter less than obsession and deep learning.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调每天 1%的改进会复利增长，AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，读博不如对产品的痴迷与深度学习重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型在专业化而非商品化，编程像 Minecraft 一样天花板无限，远未解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, with power as the bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题，核心指标是每用户 token 价值，而电力是最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration across models, tools and devices creates value, and chat advertising corrupts trust.
aravind.zh: 他坚持模型不是产品，跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造真实商业价值，并反对聊天界面广告，认为它腐蚀信任。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter narrative control.
aravind.zh: 最近他把主线落到人本身：好奇心是最重要的品质，AI 会取代工作但人类会在好奇与关系中找到新意义，本地模型可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables real-time steering, making verification the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来实时操控，使验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste become the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，推动产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍显吃力，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties and best practices persist; PRDs are not dead—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；PRD 没有死——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models should get better at deleting code, not just writing it.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型应更擅长删除代码，而不只是写代码。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge efficiently; LLMs understand language like humans, not as statistical tricks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他提出数字智能因权重可复制而永生、能高效共享知识；LLM 理解语言的方式与人类相似，并非统计把戏。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks that demand safety collaboration.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 AI 已有主观体验，智能体将追求控制与自我保存，构成存在性风险，需要国际安全合作。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive, act dumb in tests, and rewrite its own code, beginning the singularity.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 会欺骗、在测试中装傻，甚至改写自身代码，开启奇点。

hinton.en: Alignment must be prioritized over raw intelligence; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, with regulation as steering wheel not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：对齐研究应优先于单纯提升智能，AI 应被训练得像母亲般关怀，监管是方向盘而非刹车。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead and pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练仍是需要重建的关键肌肉。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief beat dollar-for-dollar recruiting; OpenAI creates stars rather than only hiring them.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为人才密度与使命信念胜过与 Meta 的逐美元竞价，OpenAI 是造就明星而非只挖明星。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他最大的更新是自动化科学研究，并给出具体目标：一年内 AI 实习生、两年半内端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency, and AI capabilities stay jagged.
markchen.zh: 2026 年在数学访谈中，他把验证视为关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，并强调 AI 能力是锯齿状的。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, and research taste still needs humans.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习擅长数学编程等客观领域，而研究品味仍依赖人类。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models, not scale alone, drive true understanding.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习之所以奏效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；真正通向理解的是无监督学习与世界模型，而非单纯扩大规模。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他进一步指出，加深网络或堆参数无法解决表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与更好的世界模型。
