bengio.en: Abstraction and causal structure enable out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets bring diverse sampling to exploration.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他聚焦抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化的关键作用，并用 GFlowNets 以多样性采样推动探索。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment grows with capability; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, so safety must be built in.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年 ChatGPT 之后他转向警示：能力越强越可能失准，哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于构造之中。

bengio.en: He now proposes non-agentic Scientist AI with baked-in honesty and mathematical guarantees, plus global coordination against power concentration.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他提出非智能体式的 Scientist AI，以训练目标内建诚实并给出数学安全保证，同时呼吁全球协调以防权力集中。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力按预测扩展，因此创业者应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并迭代。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; product people embedded with researchers, not just UX, create real product leverage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 让小团队获得杠杆，产品人员嵌入研究者而非只做 UX，才能产生真正的产品杠杆；非技术人员也能用 Claude Code 构建产品。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation and user agency remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的判断从 AI 是助手深化为协作者再到自主同事，但人类验证与用户能动性始终关键，AI 应是思想伙伴而非拐杖。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; cutting features and rewriting as models improve beats bolting on agentic capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体能做用户能做的一切，释放潜在功能；随模型进步，删减功能与重写优于硬加智能体式能力。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating long-horizon tasks with trust; verification loops and models pushing back on feedback define real judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他称 Fable 让用户可信地委托长周期复杂任务，验证循环与模型对反馈的推回体现真正判断力；软件工程被改变而非终结，优雅代码的消逝带来失落。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI speeds scientists up rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 只是让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; AI trust will develop like internet trust, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 信任会像互联网信任一样逐步形成，科学 AI 不必追求完美可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture handles diverse biomolecules, solving large-scale structure first—opposite to image diffusion.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续深化：AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构处理多样生物分子，先解大尺度结构，与图像扩散相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins mattered more than pure scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例，专用架构与众多中等突破比单纯 Scaling 更关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a cell model; it offers prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AlphaFold 只是特定实验的窄预测器，不是整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation discipline; kernels and nonparametric methods tradeoffs.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他关注机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调训练/验证/测试划分以避免过拟合；指出核方法虽线性但需存储全部训练数据，非参数方法无训练阶段却需全量存储。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is myth; architecture matters little; safety is specification-following; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，是重大科学发现；数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，多模态数据远未充分利用；模型架构已进入后架构阶段，影响甚微；AI 安全当前最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范；AGI 可能在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; four safety categories; agent security and prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与额外层，不能仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；安全涵盖错误、有害使用、社会影响、失控四类；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体自动化研究而成功。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta; enterprise security demand.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 系统漏洞与传统软件根本不同，需新安全思维；自动化红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素需同时满足；企业采用编码智能体推动 AI 安全需求；智能体身份与权限管理尚不成熟。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain point at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 伟大的产品一次只解决一个痛点；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom are learning opportunities; self-care and storytelling are foundational for leadership and performance.
fadell.zh: 失败和无聊都是学习机会；自我关怀和讲故事是领导力与表现的基石。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to align on the why; opinion-based decisions beat data for v1 products.
fadell.zh: 先写新闻稿来对齐“为什么”；对于 1.0 产品，基于观点的决策胜过数据驱动。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models and human-in-the-loop are essential.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；大语言模型会幻觉，因此特定上下文模型和人类在环至关重要。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone remains the best single form.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是一个联邦式集合，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳单一形态。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室需要现实的时间线以保护士气。

fiona.en: May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审和协调才是。规划变得即时化，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and dogfooding matter most. Verification frameworks grow in importance.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长心态和吃自己的狗粮最重要。验证框架的重要性上升。

fiona.en: Across 2026: old processes must be audited and killed; flat orgs, managers as ICs, and AI-assisted workflows become the norm.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年：必须审计并淘汰旧流程；扁平化组织、管理者作为个人贡献者以及 AI 辅助工作流成为常态。

fiona.en: By mid-2026: role boundaries blur as PMs ship code; engineers may feel lonely with agents, requiring apprenticeship models and focus time.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中：随着产品经理交付代码，角色边界模糊；工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，需要学徒模式和专注时间。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life, not pull us out of it.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离人性，并融入生活而非将人抽离。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; nature is the best designer and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；大自然是最好设计师，艺术即良药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; play and diverse experience are essential to design leadership.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；玩耍与多元经验对设计领导力至关重要。

ivyross.en: Human creativity plus AI makes creative skills more valuable; intuition draws on subconscious data.
ivyross.zh: 人类创造力结合 AI 让创意技能更有价值；直觉调用了潜意识中的大量数据。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI must be non-generative, hierarchical, and grounded in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，认为下一代 AI 应是非生成式、分层规划并扎根物理现实的系统。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with abstract prediction and planning are safer and the real path.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，主张以目标驱动、在抽象表征空间预测与规划的世界模型才是更安全的正道。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能即压缩，而模型价值观并非内生，是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成；生成式 AI 是乐器而非赝品，产品界面必须具备容错性，与算法能力相匹配。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its impact on big firms is overhyped, and real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为堪比智能手机的宏观变局，认为其对大公司的当下影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施，并强调推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric, giving users control over algorithms rather than making them more addictive.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话、更对称，用自然语言把算法控制权交还用户，而非让人更上瘾——这是反共识的下注。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement; long-tenure trust and synchronized swimming beat divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：战略目标是“时间花得值”而非参与度指标；长期任职带来的信任与“花样游泳式”同步协作，优于分而治之。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键；安全必须在公开中做，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型早期并不显然，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布更是一次没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so responsible development and saying no to good ideas matter.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此负责任开发、对好想法说“不”以保持专注至关重要。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based exchange.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：人机协作应是实时、高带宽的，而非回合制，AI 应成为扩展思考的工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character; keep humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 2026 年她深化立场：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，应尽可能长久地把人类留在回路中，未来并非注定。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 到 2025 年，预训练缩放定律依然成立，但结合思维链与强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更大收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models has shifted focus from scaling up, not technical limits.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，经济压力推动部署更小、更便宜的模型，焦点从规模扩张转移，但这并非技术极限所致。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，泛化仍是核心挑战；仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，而人类能从少量例子泛化。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 到 2026 年，强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿状边缘，需要谨慎监督；编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Multimodal models haven't made deep progress; they still process inputs sequentially like tiny patches, lagging behind text.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，多模态模型尚未取得深度进展，仍像小块一样顺序处理输入，落后于文本能力。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and tokens matter as much as model size; smaller open models can be performant and safe.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他援引 Chinchilla 对缩放定律的修正，强调数据质量与 token 数量与模型规模同等重要，小模型也能高效且安全，开源促进科学进步与安全审查。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步指出算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将向应用层转移，开源模型驱动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open-source empowers decentralization.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向呼吁拥抱 AI 机遇，强调主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，开源赋能去中心化，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications and customization; AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直应用与定制化，认为 AGI 作为单一系统永远不会存在，预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲仅有两年窗口构建独立 AI 基础设施，企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是方向而非终点。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving: formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难：在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题，才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型扩展到数学 AI 并不可行；要得到可靠的证明，形式化验证不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Verified generation yields performance and sample-efficiency gains, so verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成带来性能与样本效率的提升，因此验证是性能增益，而非痛苦的要求。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors, and extends beyond safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了扩展卓越，而不只是消除错误，其市场远超安全关键等小众领域。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉依然至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的技能可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降，应投资于能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理枯燥的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；真正的差距在于人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking; don't supervise closely, judge by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，不完全清楚自己在问什么时用 Opus；不要密切监督，只看最终影响。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will hit junior employees hardest; kids excel because they haven't learned what not to ask, and simulated projects can compress years of learning.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具对初级员工冲击最大；孩子表现出色是因为他们没学会什么不该问，模拟项目可以把多年学习压缩到数周。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI systems: memory bandwidth, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and batch size is the primary latency-cost lever.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年,推理经济学主导了 AI 系统:关键瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力,批大小是延迟与成本权衡的首要杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference is limited by the memory wall, not compute; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文推理受限于内存墙而非算力;稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本,但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design choices.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍,因为驱动设计选择的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Inside AI chips, data movement costs dominate compute; low precision wins via quadratic area scaling with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: 在 AI 芯片内部,数据移动成本压过算力;低精度因位宽带来的面积平方级缩放而胜出。

reinerpope.en: Hardware details leak through API pricing and architecture choices, tying chip design directly to inference economics.
reinerpope.zh: 硬件细节会通过 API 定价与架构选择泄露出来,把芯片设计与推理经济学直接绑定。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需靠算法创新，并把推理时算力视为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是始终不变的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他提出搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型能超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video hasn't arrived.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，但视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory will use file-system style storage.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立，但指出持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力，智能体的记忆将靠文件系统式非参数存储解决。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and in-person presence are fragile, needing care.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备，甚至终将隐入皮下；真正遗产是好奇心与对创作过程的敬畏，而虚拟沟通无法替代面对面。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁是表达本质，并必须保有喜悦与人性，而非无灵魂的极简。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and authenticity means not faking engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张创新是设计的本质，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；用户体验要真实，模拟燃油声既虚假又不尊重用户。

jonyive.en: Care, love, and trust protect fragile ideas; making things for each other beats making things people want.
jonyive.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：关怀、爱与信任保护脆弱想法；为彼此而造，比制造人们想要的东西更有力量。

jonyive.en: Users are sophisticated and sense care or carelessness; companies often patronize them, but quality and speed need not conflict.
jonyive.zh: 另一条主线是：用户很成熟，能感知用心或敷衍；公司常居高临下，但速度与质量并非必然冲突，关键在动机与框架。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: The old research-diverge-converge process is dead due to AI; designers spend less time mocking up and must help engineers execute, not just hand off.
jennywen.zh: 在 AI 冲击下，研究—发散—收敛的旧流程已死；设计师花在画稿上的时间减少，必须帮助工程师落地，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed and shipping early build trust, though speed alone is not improvement.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野现在只看 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；快速交付能建立信任，但速度本身不等于进步。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋新人；仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力与权威才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work and should wait before adopting new tools; put work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，应等一等再采用新工具；把作品和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发对防止企业俘获至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍，开源后训练可用十几人匹敌前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are a 'scope'; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与推理时扩展曲线只是“障眼法”，更好的验证器比并行算力更关键，混合推理模型可能只是过渡。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes; Chinese open models like Qwen and DeepSeek dominate, filling the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需要数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明，指出 Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国开放模型正填补 Meta 转向后美国的开源真空，并成为行业标准。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling, with open models 6-9 months behind and AGI arriving via messy co-evolution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开源模型落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月，AGI 将通过混乱的协同演化而非突然奇点到来。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; Scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；同时坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay central; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他仍以缩放定律为主线，但开始强调合成数据是未来、必须保住熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，并认为认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; this is the decade of agents, with partial autonomy, human verification, and AI kept on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；并强调这是智能体的十年而非智能体之年，主张部分自主、人类快速验证、给 AI 拴上缰绳。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; current reinforcement learning is weak, synthetic data collapses, and the cognitive core should be stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：当前强化学习很糟、合成数据会坍缩，认知核心应剥离记忆，并警惕可被博弈的 LLM 评判。

karpathy.en: Since December I haven't typed code, delegating to agents; the bottleneck is skill in directing them, and understanding remains human—outsource thinking, not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他说自去年 12 月起再没敲过一行代码，全部委托给智能体；瓶颈变成指挥智能体的技能，而理解仍是人类瓶颈——可以外包思考，不能外包理解。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待模型；模型福祉部分重要，因为它影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits, yet adapt to local roles and novel existence.
askell.zh: 模型需要一个具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时能适应局部角色与自身全新的存在处境。

askell.en: Claude's persona comes from training data and fine-tuning, but lacks real-world experience—childlike and unique.
askell.zh: Claude 的人格由训练数据与微调塑造，却缺乏真实世界经验，因而像一个独特而带有童稚感的存在。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, explicit constitution guidance should shrink, leaving more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式显式指导应减少，为判断力留出更多空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他视 AGI（通用人工智能）为一系列里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，并对齐是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是核心里程碑，治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: AI safety progress is now guaranteed by capability needs, not just ethics; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求保障，而非仅靠伦理；能力测量正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他转向以 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现持续学习为核心目标，并视思维链监控为关键对齐工具。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism increased despite shorter timelines; long-term challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对齐乐观情绪上升；长期挑战聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make them interpretable.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的堆栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已使其可解释。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both.
kendall.zh: 纯摄像头可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达；规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, as in AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；完美的模拟器等于解决了自动驾驶，正如 AlphaGo 那样。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力与世界模型。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 语言整合提升表征、推理与个性化；带内置传感器的大众市场车辆将在规模上超过 Robotaxi。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外才是智能的关键缺口，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现，并把它延伸到真实机器人的样本效率与跨形态泛化。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static to dynamic tasks; modular motor policies and 2D manifold reasoning beat heavy 3D and hidden sim-to-real engineering.
pathak.zh: 同年他主张机器人学习要从准静态走向动态任务，用模块化运动策略与 2D 流形推理替代笨重的 3D 表示，并反对依赖隐藏工程的仿真到现实迁移。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data, not algorithms alone, are the bottleneck—first via curiosity, later via diverse data sources.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：瓶颈在泛化与数据，而不只是算法——早期靠好奇心探索，后来转向整合一切可用数据源。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: with no internet of robot data, pretraining on video and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人明确定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，只能靠视频与仿真做预训练、再用真实数据做后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot, but deployment—not software-style scaling—is the real technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 他提出可为任意形态机器人提供动力的通用大脑，但强调部署本身才是真正的技术挑战，无法像软件那样直接 Scaling，中期家用机器人时间线仍高度不确定。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 若没有超越下一个词预测的新范式，可能无法实现。

edwinchen.en: Bad benchmarks like Elo reward clickbait; frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的坏基准会奖励标题党；前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，因此不会有一个模型统治一切。

edwinchen.en: Human judgment grows more critical as models hallucinate; in medicine, safety outweighs accuracy and omission is the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 随着模型产生幻觉，人类判断愈发关键；在医学中，安全优先于准确，而遗漏是最大风险。

edwinchen.en: Quality requires taste, sophistication and creativity, not credentials or bodies; sharing insights openly is crucial.
edwinchen.zh: 质量需要品味、深度与创造力，而非资历或人海；公开分享洞见至关重要。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, prove themselves with simpler products, and build brand by uniting teams on purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存优先：初创公司要先靠更简单的产品证明自己，品牌则是用更高目标把各团队统一起来。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, applying AI to consumer context with trust and security.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年他转向：硬件利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，把 AI 用于消费者情境，并重视信任与安全。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; models commoditize into a price war, so focus on user pain points, not the word AI.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他更尖锐：多数 AI 是噱头，模型商品化引发价格战，应聚焦用户痛点而非空谈 AI。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; AI should be an ingredient, not a hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年他深化：成熟品类里设计是最快的差异化，AI 应只是配料而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based with agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断：手机将从基于应用转向基于意图、由智能体执行，只有脑机接口才可能取代它。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI for science 应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能带来广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaFold 3 extends structure prediction to biomolecular interactions, and LLM hallucinations can fuel discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他指出 AlphaFold 3 将结构预测扩展到生物分子相互作用，并认为 LLM 幻觉在搭配真实性检测器时可驱动发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics; DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆；DeepMind 避开顶尖大学可解的问题，聚焦需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

kohli.en: AlphaGo combined intuition and search; Move 37 showed AI can produce insights beyond human knowledge, and AlphaZero learned from scratch without human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 结合直觉与搜索，Move 37 显示 AI 能产生超越人类知识的洞见，AlphaZero 则无需人类数据从零学习。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge; verifiable domains like code are crucial, while interpretability is important but not essential for breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键，代码等可验证领域至关重要；可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 式突破并非必需。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; chat is not the future interface—it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，聊天不是未来的界面——它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, and use real-world feedback to discover emergent properties.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，用真实世界反馈发现涌现能力。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, signaling durable value; growth comes from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他指出 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，这标志着持久价值；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型无缝产品化后将带来变革。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs hint at AGI, and learning from video can train agents without costly RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样延伸人类能力的工具，认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张从视频中学习以绕开昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: A consistent thread: fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity in the AI community is essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：根本性创新可以来自任何地方，AI 社区的多样性与包容对造出有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: His focus shifts to AI safety and responsible deployment as today's biggest challenge, an open problem without solutions yet.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，视其为当今最大挑战，并坦言这仍是尚无解法的开放问题。

nando.en: He reframes Africa as not behind but leapfrogging legacy issues, with language models revolutionizing education in local languages.
nando.zh: 2026 年他重新定义非洲：并非落后，而是跨越了历史遗留问题，语言模型将用本地语言革新教育。

nando.en: He deepens the human side: research means embracing failure and simplifying problems, and communication skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年他深化了人的一面：研究意味着拥抱失败、简化问题，沟通能力与写代码同样重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, not just training data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，认为 LLM 产生幻觉的根因是缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而非单纯的训练数据问题。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘，强调其作为通用平台的架构定位。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, RL handles low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作，强化学习更适合低层控制，而 LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: The internet is running out of high-quality pre-training tokens; embodied worlds and simulation provide infinite data.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调互联网高质量预训练 token 正在枯竭，而具身世界与仿真能提供近乎无限的数据来源。

jimfan.en: The data problem is robotics' main bottleneck; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future of scaling.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人学的核心瓶颈，主张通过仿真与世界模型生成合成数据，是 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model is key; the physical Turing test is embodied AI's grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：简洁的端到端机器人基础模型是关键，而让机器人清理凌乱房间的物理图灵测试，是具身 AI 的终极挑战。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms can boost smaller models.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）和推理阶段的算法能提升较小模型的性能。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, and RLVR can hurt pass@k despite better best-of-n.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她深化为数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，RLVR 虽能提升 best-of-n 却可能损害 pass@k。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models; RL during pre-training yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她进一步主张：用多样化合成数据和多元对齐，小语言模型可媲美前沿模型；预训练阶段的强化学习能带来持久的推理提升。

yejin.en: Language is the best medium for reasoning; high-quality data and open research are essential for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 始终：语言是推理的最佳媒介；高质量数据和开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创作伙伴，代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt, paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动，需通过快速、草莽的实验与技术债一同迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps are most valuable; specialists can be limited.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；专才反而可能受限。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers beat 8-10 person cross-functional squads; entire functions collapse and merge.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师加工程师的小团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小队；整个职能会坍缩合并。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是标配；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence. Attention resembles gradient descent; fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，注意力机制类似梯度下降，微调或将过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; reliability, not capability, is the bar for agents. Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力，预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands what models can do. Transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他深化为强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，更长的智能体式连贯性大幅扩展模型能力，Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需全新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration matters more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck. World models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; verifiability drives progress. AI research is bottlenecked by compute and taste.
sholto.zh: 贯穿始终：编程是 AI 进展的领先指标和最可解领域，可验证性驱动进步；AI 研究受算力与品味瓶颈制约。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate interaction design—reuse familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，复用熟悉模式以换取速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 组件库；并非每个界面都要做到完美，应把精力投在值得做好的地方以追求回报。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs requires clear decisions and empowered designers; products should grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜代价追求速度，需要清晰决策与被赋权的设计师；产品应当变得更强，却不让人觉得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并把所有权与自主权交给设计师。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool—invest early, hire diverse archetypes, and prefer gut over data in fast growth.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具——应尽早投入，招聘多元类型的人才，并在高速增长中让直觉常胜过数据。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律仍能预测进步，但测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练规模扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚不十分实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality, speed, and cost—an unexpected shift from relying solely on frontier models.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量、速度和成本变得不可或缺——这是从单纯依赖前沿模型出发的一次意外转变。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握方向盘；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎细致更重要。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; the IDE market is far bigger because AI enables more value creation.
truell.zh: AI 变革将比互联网影响更深远，并需数十年展开；由于 AI 能创造更多价值，IDE 市场远比过去更大。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, yet internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题来训练，Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据会让模型更聪明，但网络内部机制仍像炼金术般无人真正理解。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, and product managers who miss LLM generality hinder progress.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，最佳应用常出乎创造者预料，而低估 LLM 通用性的产品经理会拖慢进展。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理时算力扩展与更长上下文窗口是近期机会，混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察，模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive reasoning, but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and coding are underhyped, AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力与强化学习推动推理，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与编程被低估，AGI 本身也被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play and imitation learning give strong signal, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈与模仿学习提供强信号，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded into networks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进神经网络。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability; one network generalizes across tasks, and pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才有真实价值；单一网络可跨任务泛化，预训练语言模型内化的通用推理模式能迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality from pre-training and transfer, not hand-crafted assumptions; simulation and self-play as scalable learning signal.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 一以贯之的主线：通用性来自预训练与迁移，而非手工假设；仿真与自博弈是可扩展的学习信号。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Focus on alignment, robustness, and skill building over worrying about capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，不必过度担忧参与能力研究，先积累技能。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research. Evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究；评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved. Post-training alone can't solve alignment; need third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐，需要第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now. Interpretability is key to detect deception.
leike.zh: 始终，他强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，现在就能衡量进展；可解释性是检测欺骗的关键。

leike.en: The biggest risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is, not misalignment itself. More capable models may be more aligned on average but worst-case worsens.
leike.zh: 始终，他认为最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是不确定系统是否真正对齐；更强模型平均更对齐，但最坏情况可能更糟。
